name: Khamenei.ir — Official Website
description: Official multilingual website of Ayatollah Khamenei with statements, speeches, Islamic guidance, books and thematic collections. Useful for users seeking Iranian leadership perspectives and published material.

name: Noor Digital Library (Noorlib)
description: Major Iranian digital library from the Computer Research Center of Islamic Sciences (Noor), with tens of thousands of Islamic-science titles, search tools and researcher workspaces.

name: Hawzah.net
description: Long-running Iranian hawza portal with Quran, Nahj al-Balagha, Sahifa Sajjadiya, large article banks, Q&A and scholarly material — a primary Persian Shia knowledge site since the late 1990s.

name: Jami' al-Ahadith (Noor Hadith)
description: Comprehensive Shia hadith database from Noor (CRCIS), indexing hundreds of thousands of narrations from classical sources with search and comparison tools.

name: Noor Software (Noorsoft)
description: Software and digital products from Iran’s Computer Research Center of Islamic Sciences — encyclopedias, hadith tools, Ahlulbayt knowledge bases and related research software.

name: Tebyan
description: Large Iranian cultural and educational portal with Islamic books, articles and multimedia; English section includes thousands of Shia-oriented articles and readings.

name: Ghaemiyeh Digital Library
description: Iranian digital book market / library offering free access to thousands of Shia and Islamic titles in multiple formats (PDF and apps), widely used for offline study.

name: Madrasa Fiqahat Library (eshia)
description: Searchable free library used by hawza students, covering fiqh, Quranic sciences, hadith and history with text search and copy-friendly access.

name: IslamQuest
description: Question-and-answer platform on Islamic topics from a Shia perspective, available in Persian, English and Arabic — useful for clear written answers on beliefs and practice.

name: Imam Reza Network
description: Long-running Iranian Ahlulbayt educational network with articles, multimedia and religious learning material connected with the Imam Reza (a.s.) cultural sphere.
